technique_name: Write a story beginning with the following sentence: It was raining hard that day.
description: It was raining hard that day, thunder rumbling in the distance. Patricia shivered in the cool, damp air, feeling sad and alone. She had been eagerly awaiting this day for weeks, but now it seemed ruined by the weather. She had planned to take the bus to her cousin's birthday party, but now those plans were washed away. Suddenly, Patricia had an idea. She pulled her coat a little tighter against the chill and ventured out in the rain. She wanted to give her cousin the most special gift she could
